{{Top}}
A '''plasma cutter''' was a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-based cutting tool. The [[Iskalloni]] employed plasma cutters to force entry into captured [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Iska">{{WEGCite|story=The Iskallon Factor|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> Additionally, the [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]-developed [[Uggernaught]] exoskeleton featured a plasma cutter for construction and maintenance tasks.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|276|Uggernaught}}</ref> [[Construction droid/Legends|Construction droids]] such as the [[EVS Construction Droid]] utilized plasma cutters to assist in destroying buildings.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
